entities.summary: Jacques François Joseph Saly, also known as Jacques Saly, French-born sculptor who worked in France, Italy and Malta. He is commonly associated with his time in Denmark he served as Director of the Royal Danish Academy of Art (1754–71). His most noteworthy work is the equestrian statue Frederik V on Horseback at Amalienborg. Jacques Saly was a painters & sculptors from Valenciennes (1717-06-20, Valenciennes–1776-05-04). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
